reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience working with Rod and the team on our fence project. From the start, they were punctual and kept us updated every step of the way with clear and professional communication.

What really stood out was how well they handled unexpected challenges—navigating them quickly and effectively without ever compromising quality. Their work ethic and attention to detail gave us so much confidence that we actually added a second job with them before the first one was even finished!

If you’re looking for a team that’s reliable, skilled, and a pleasure to work with, we highly recommend A&A Fence and Concrete.

reviews.text: I had my wood fence replaced by A and A Fence & Concrete.  Sales Rep Kyle was very professional and knowledgeable. reviews.text: A&A did an excellent job on our fence! Austin was great to work with and answered all of my questions during the quote process to get us exactly what we wanted. His crew was able to complete the job in one day and it looks great! I would definitely  recommend this company!

reviews.text: We used A and A fifteen years ago. That fence is still in great condition. Recently, we reached out to them for a new project with about 175’ of fence. There were some pesky details to work through with a utility pole, 3 neighbor fences, and some height changes. Salesman, Kyle, was detail-oriented and stayed involved through all the process. The installers were great about getting very straight post lines and also courteous. They didn’t leave messes in the yard.
reviews.author: Lori B

reviews.text: Our experience with Rod and the entire A and A family was wonderful!  He educated us on the quality of wood we were buying to understand the investment we were making in our fence.  He found the perfect color, chestnut, which coordinated perfectly with the dark trim on our house.  He was always available when I had questions and responded to emails/texts quickly.  The installation crew was exceptional too.  They were on time, worked hard to install everything we asked for in a timely manner. and were incredibly polite when I had questions.  We even added a new fence along the driveway at the last minute and they were able to accommodate and finish it along with the backyard fence.  The experience we had was one of the best ever! I would highly recommend A and A Fence & Concrete (especially Rod).
